Pipeline tab: pipeline-funnel-canvas with 6 funnel-stage-* rows + forecast-widget with 4 forecast-bucket-* tiles. Kanban tab: leads-kanban with all 7 kanban-col-* columns + 19 kanban-card-* cards. AI follow-up: drawer-ai-draft-followup successfully calls /api/leads/{id}/ai-draft-email and renders drawer-draft-email + drawer-copy-email button (verified subject 'Following up — TEST_iter174_ct' visible). Create Ticket dialog: drawer-create-ticket-btn opens dialog with pre-filled title + description, confirm-create-ticket button posts and toast 'Ticket #SR-00xx created from this lead' appears. Merge into Ticket: drawer-merge-into-ticket-btn opens dialog, typing 'INC' in merge-ticket-search debounced-fetches 15 results, selecting + confirm-merge-into-ticket posts and shows toast 'Merged into ticket #INC-0008'; lead status flips to 'Won' as expected. Quick Add: leads-quick-add opens QuickAddPasteDialog, pasting parsed text and clicking quick-add-parse-btn shows toast 'Parsed — review and save the new lead' and opens New Lead create dialog pre-filled (Brightleaf / Sarah Reynolds / sarah@brightleaf.com.au / +61 411 234 567 / brightleaf.com.au / CTO). Bulk bar: leads-bulk-bar renders correctly when two checkboxes are selected programmatically.

minor.issue: Spec in review_request said POST /api/lead-studio/{id}/touch but the actual route is POST /api/leads/{lead_id}/touch (which is what the frontend calls). Either align the docs/spec to the implemented path, or add a /lead-studio/{id}/touch alias so both forms work.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking the row-level checkbox via mouse opens the drawer instead of toggling selection — the <tr> onClick handler fires before/instead of the input change because the checkbox cell is not stopping propagation. Workaround in test: programmatic click via JS. Real users will be unable to multi-select with the mouse, which breaks the bulk-bar flow entirely.

row-create-ticket-<id> and row-merge-ticket-<id> testids do NOT exist in the DOM until the row's MoreVertical menu is opened (count = 0 on a fresh page). That's expected only if the menu lazy-renders, but the spec implies they should be reachable from a known testid pattern. Document the trigger (click row's [aria-haspopup=menu] first) or pre-render the items in a hidden DropdownMenuContent for testability.

issues: Hero stats card 'TOTAL LEADS 19' spans full width and dwarfs the 4-stat layout the spec describes — only 1 of the 4 stat-* tiles is visible above the fold; stat-open/stat-pipeline-value/stat-hot exist in the DOM but are likely hidden behind the CRM Live ticker or stacked vertically. Verify the flex/grid is rendering them side-by-side at 1920×1100.

action_items: Fix row-level checkbox click hijacking — stopPropagation on the checkbox cell so clicking the box toggles selection without opening the drawer (critical for the bulk-bar flow to be usable by real users).
Either align /touch endpoint path with the spec or add an alias under /lead-studio/{id}/touch.

Make row-create-ticket-<id>/row-merge-ticket-<id> testids assertable from the row level (consider pre-rendering hidden DropdownMenuItem so QA can target them without opening the menu, or document the menu-open prerequisite in the spec).
Audit Lead Studio hero layout — only stat-total visibly renders above the fold at 1920×1100; the other 3 stat-* tiles need to be in a 4-up grid alongside it.
critical_code_review_comments: lead_studio.py is 742 lines — at the >700 line guideline. Split into lead_studio_analytics.py (score/hot/stale/forecast/velocity/source/funnel/ticker), lead_studio_ai.py (NBA/draft-email/quick-parse), lead_studio_crud.py (saved-views/tasks/recently-viewed/touch), lead_studio_actions.py (win-loss/bulk-action/merge-into-ticket).

/api/leads/{lead_id}/touch lives in lead_studio.py but routes under /leads/{lead_id} — make sure the existing GET /api/leads/{lead_id} in the legacy crm.py router still wins for GET (it does, since methods are different) and document that lead_studio.py owns POST /leads/{id}/touch + /win-loss + /merge-into-ticket + /ai-draft-email + /next-best-action + /tasks to avoid future prefix collisions.

ai-draft-email returns {subject, body, intent} per spec — confirmed for all 4 intents, but the body is templated, not LLM-generated. Consider noting this in the docs or wiring it through the existing _llm_complete helper for richer output.

Frontend LeadsPage.jsx (417 lines) wires 13+ subcomponents — acceptable but row-click vs checkbox-click event bubbling is fragile. Use event.stopPropagation in the <td> wrapping the checkbox, or move selection to a click on the avatar instead.

merge-into-ticket force-sets lead.status='won' — this is correct per spec but skips win-loss reason capture. Consider opening the win-loss reason modal client-side after a successful merge so the source-attribution pie stays accurate.

rca_of_the_issue: Bulk checkbox UX bug: the table row uses an onClick handler to open the drawer, and the checkbox cell does NOT stopPropagation, so mouse-clicking the checkbox both toggles its checked state (briefly) and bubbles up to the row, which opens the drawer and re-renders the row — net effect: checkbox state never sticks for the user. Fix: wrap checkbox <td> with onClick={(e)=>e.stopPropagation()} or move the checkbox into a separate clickable area that swallows the click. Programmatic click via JS works in tests because the synthetic click doesn't trigger the bubble path the same way.
